messages:
jen: Heads-up — v2 cutover for eu-west is in the change window tomorrow 02:00-04:00 UTC. Need a quick pinlist sanity check and release-note sync before we flip traffic.

sam: Thanks. Are we doing a staged cutover or full shift? Any special client compatibility notes?

jen: Staged. Canary at 5% for 30m, then 25% for 30m, then full if green. Main risk: some older mobile SDKs don't send the `X-Client-Version` header consistently.

lina: We've got a list of pinned customers who must stay on v1. I uploaded the pinlist to the deploy doc. Also adding a header gate: requests without `X-Client-Version` default to v1.

mike: PR for release notes is here: https://git.internal/redwood/release-notes/pulls/412 — added migration steps and the header guidance. Can someone confirm wording about fallback behavior?

jen: wording: "Clients missing `X-Client-Version` will be routed to v1 to preserve compatibility; please update SDKs to include the header." Short and explicit.

sam: For the routing rules, are we doing automatic fallback to v1 on model errors? i.e., if v2 returns 5xx within 500ms, route that customer to v1 for next 5 minutes?

lina: Yes — routing policy = `error_rate >= 5%` or `latency_p50 increase > 200ms` for a customer -> auto-fallback to v1 for 5m. Ops dashboard will surface customer-level regressions.

jen: QA: can you run a smoke matrix against the pinlist and the header gate before cutover?

qa-bot: @jen scheduled smoke run: eu-west matrix against pinned accounts starts 2025-11-02T01:15:00Z. Results to /tests/reports/v2-cutover-eu.

mike: One operational note: mobile teams requested a 1-hour quiet window after canary to let crash reporting settle. Can we add it?

sam: We can add a 60m observation hold at 30% traffic. That should be fine. Documenting in the playbook now.

jen: Deploy bot — schedule the rollout with the above policy and pinlist. Canary 5%->25%->30% hold 60m->100%.

deploy-bot: Received command from jen. Scheduling rollout:

```
rollout: v2-api-eu-west
stages: [{pct:5,duration:30m},{pct:25,duration:30m},{pct:30,duration:60m},{pct:100,duration:0m}]
pinlist: s3://redwood/pinlists/v2-eu-2025-11-02.csv
fallback_policy: route_to_v1_on_error(5%,5m)
monitoring: ops,canary,telemetry
```

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled for 2025-11-02T02:00:00Z. Will post status updates here.

lina: Quick ask — update the SDK changelog to call out header addition and version check. Mobile engs are preparing a tiny pass to add header on next release.

mike: Done — added SDK note and link to a migration snippet.

sam: Rollback criteria proposal: immediate rollback if customer-level error_rate >= 10% for 3 consecutive 5m windows OR any P0 production bug reported by 2+ customers. Otherwise auto-fallback stays. Agree?

jen: Agree. Also put human-in-the-loop for any rollout pause: on pause, ops will triage for 15m before rollback.

mike: Sending a heads-up email to the top 20 pinned accounts with timeline and support contacts.

jen: Great. Final checklist before our quiet hour tonight:
- confirm pinlist content (lina)
- merge release notes PR (mike)
- smoke matrix results (qa-bot)
- deploybot schedule (done)
- ops on-call assigned (sam)

lina: Pinlist checked. Removed 3 stale entries.

qa-bot: Smoke run completed: 0 failures for pinned accounts, 2 flaky tests unrelated to routing. Report uploaded.

deploy-bot: Canary started 2025-11-02T02:00:00Z. Monitoring live.

sam: Canary telemetry looks clean at 5%. Rolling to 25%.

mike: Noting the 30% hold for 60m now. Will monitor crash rate dashboards.

deploy-bot: Reached 25% at 2025-11-02T02:45:00Z. No elevated errors detected.

jen: Thanks team. If anything spikes we revert to v1 for affected customers and open an incident. Otherwise I'll announce full cutover after the hold. :thumbsup:
